general_american.label: American English
general_american.description: Draft General American targets. Accepted reductions are listed below; model decisions remain experimental.

sentences.focus: TH /θ/ in think; IH /ɪ/ as in sit, not EE /i/.
EH /ɛ/ in bed versus AE /æ/ in bad; voiced TH /ð/ in the.
SH /ʃ/ and IH /ɪ/ in ship, not sheep; rhotic R /ɹ/ in here.

general_american.variation_note: The may use /ðə/ or emphasized /ði/; is may reduce to /əz/; here may use an /ɪ/ or /i/ vowel before /ɹ/. These are draft variants, not an exhaustive inventory of American speech. The model may not reliably recognize unreleased stops or every allophone.
